job.title: IT Support Engineer I, Amazon OTS
job.pay_full: $27.21 – $37.50 an hour base pay (Waco, TX), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: OTS provides nonstop global IT support to Amazon Operations, whose buildings ship tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries every day. As an IT Support Engineer I, you implement technical solutions and support computer hardware, operating systems and enterprise software across sites in a defined area, and solve straightforward problems that have no set procedure.
duties: Network engineering and troubleshooting, data cabling and systems administration across software and hardware environments
Keep networking and computing systems available during production hours
Give management and staff analytical and technical help to improve IT solutions
Maintain or create policies, procedures and processes
Find root causes of operational issues and process inefficiencies
Support customers across several buildings in the area, and remote customers
Travel within your local or regional area to support customers
needs: 1+ years with Windows Server technologies: AD, DFS, Print Services, SCCM
2+ years troubleshooting in a multi-user, high-availability environment
2+ years of PC repair, troubleshooting, deployment and liquidation
1+ years of IT client, server and network service delivery
2+ years of networking (such as DNS, DHCP, SSL, OSI model and TCP/IP)
2+ years supporting Windows, Mac or Linux in a corporate setting
2+ years supporting and maintaining a corporate network
nice: Experience supporting video and teleconference equipment
details.benefits: Base pay $27.21 – $37.50 an hour (Waco, TX). The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Healthcare benefits start on day 1, and the posting mentions up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, basic life and AD&D insurance with optional supplemental life, an employee assistance program, mental health support, a medical advice line, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Casual dress code (jeans, t-shirts, safety shoes, and at times a safety vest)
Local and regional travel to support customers
Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
